page.notes: The section mark "§. IX." at the upper right is a printed section marker, not part of the running head, so it is not transcribed as one. Greek word "αὐτοκρατορικὴ" is a best reading across a line break ("αὐτο-" / "κρατορικὴ"); the hyphen and accents are uncertain. The last word "magumen-" is broken at the line end with "gumen-" printed right-aligned; the completion is not legible. The paragraph continues onto the next page. The first line "DD. Proff. Lyd." opens the column in the same type as the text and is treated as continuation from the previous page's note.
